Julian Woods is a former English cricketer who was born on May 28, 1982, in Hammersmith, London. He was a right-handed batsman and a right-arm medium-fast bowler. Woods made his debut for Hampshire in first-class cricket in 2001 and played for the county until 2006.

He also played for Essex and Yorkshire in his first-class career. Woods represented England at the Under-19 level and was regarded as a promising young talent in English cricket.

However, Woods struggled with injuries throughout his career, which ultimately cut his professional playing career short. He retired from professional cricket in 2009 at the age of 27.

Since retiring from playing, Woods has worked as a cricket coach, helping to develop young players and passing on his knowledge and experience of the game.
